lines: # Read before writing anything public. No exceptions.
## Never use
delve, leverage, utilise, robust, seamless, unlock, harness,
elevate, supercharge, game changer, landscape, tapestry,
testament, pivotal, crucial, vital
## Never open with
"In today's fast-paced world"  "Let's dive in"
"Here's the thing nobody tells you"  "Most people do this wrong"
## Never build
- eight single-sentence lines in a row
- "It's not X. It's Y." as its own line
- three fragments in a row. "No context. No structure. No memory."
- "Amateurs do X. Professionals do Y."
- a question close. "comment YES". "repost this". "save this"
- an em dash, an exclamation mark, an emoji, a hashtag block
## Always
- UK English. Dates as 20 July 2026.
- the specific thing, never the general claim
- every number carries a source and a date
- nothing invented. no client, quote or result we do not have
- vary the paragraph. some are three sentences. some are one.
## Before it ships
Read the first two lines aloud. If they could sit on any
AI account with the name swapped, start again.
